intro: ten demo pages and a page per package over the 24 packages. models download from their upstream host when you ask, each page states the weight licence before it loads, and nothing is hosted here.
footer: code mit. pages built from github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-browser-ai. no weights or model files are hosted here.

pages.name: chat
pages.what: one streaming interface over webllm, transformers.js, wllama, the prompt api and remote endpoints, with time to first token and tokens per second.

pages.name: transcribe
pages.what: whisper through the quiet speech front end: drop a file, or speak a sentence with kokoro and read it back.

pages.name: speak
pages.what: kokoro 82m on wasm or webgpu and the system voice through one speaker, with time to first audio and word offsets.

pages.name: vision
pages.what: depth anything, mediapipe detection, slimsam masks and smolvlm captions on a scene built in code, with the frame cost of each.

pages.name: depth-mesh
pages.what: depth map to a closed relief solid, and silhouettes on a turntable carved to a hull. stl out.

pages.name: embed
pages.what: potion-base-8M static embedder and minilm or bge-small through transformers.js, with a search over 20 sentences.

pages.name: audio-dsp
pages.what: rust wasm dsp core: filters, noise floor, spectral subtraction, limiter, stft, tempo. a click track and a 10 minute timing run.

pages.name: devices
pages.what: capability probe, pinned runtime imports, resumable weight downloads and sha-256 speed.

pages.name: imagegen
pages.what: sd-turbo on onnxruntime-web webgpu with a seeded euler loop. 2.5 GB of weights you download on request.

pages.name: ai-elements
pages.what: model picker, download bar, status pills, chat panel and memory inspector as web components.
